user.title: Add a PC
user.description: Choose a name, and the address this PC will use to reach Home Assistant.

progress.wait_for_agent:
On the PC, copy this whole line, then double-click homeydeck-ha-agent.exe and click Yes:

`{code}`

This screen moves on by itself once the PC is paired. The code works once, for {minutes} minutes.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full address, like http://192.168.1.10:8123

abort.code_expired: The pairing code expired before the PC used it. Add the PC again to get a new one.
